Emily —

Appreciate the clarity and the target dates. Short answer: yes, we can support a staggered activation tied to the same MSA, but there are three dependency buckets that will determine exact weeks: legal redlines (MSA/DPA), evidence (SOC 2 / audit artifacts), and procurement (PO timing + billing terms).

I'm looping Laura (legal lead for mid-market) to scope the redline effort and Marcus to size infra commitments for the pilot SLA. Quick outline I propose as a starting MAP:

Week 0–1: Finalize commercial terms & identify single signatory for orderform (procurement).
Week 1–2: Legal consolidates redlines (MSA v3), confirm DPA parameters; Redwood provides a redline-ready MSA and an evidence checklist.
Week 2–3: Security validation — SOC 2 artifacts, gap list; if minor, we provide a time-limited exception for pilot.
Week 3–4: Pilot activation (limited seats, telemetry access, explicit acceptance criteria).
Week 4–6: Address any remaining legal edits, finalize orderform; PO issued and production activation.

Two notes: 1) if GreenLeaf requires full DPA sign-off before any pilot, that pushes the earliest pilot to week 4; 2) redlines that touch data residency or logging will typically add 1–2 weeks.

I attached the MSA redlines we usually start from and a short checklist for evidence requests.
